audit.threshold_warning: Arbitrary GIS distance filters; not hazard, flood depth, evacuation or safe-setback thresholds.
limitations: Uploaded village point records only; not proof of complete/current village or ward coverage.
No township boundary polygons, village footprints, measured terrain, rainfall grids, river stages, tides or confirmed flood reports were added.
KML point altitude values of 0 were not treated as measured ground elevations.
Generalized line geometry does not define the physical bank; some small channels/drains are absent.
Nearest line may be across a ridge or catchment divide; distance does not establish hydrological connectivity.
Basin/coastal polygons are supplied coarse hydrological units; coastal group polygons can contain separate catchments.
Basin-edge proximity flag is a review aid only; horizontal error bounds are not known.
No new weather forecast is issued. Previous screenshots were not interpolated to villages.
Field status for every village is Not checked.
